name: The Bull Series
tagline: Three decades, three collections, and the anthology that gathers them.
description: Brian's origin as a poet. Bull Head collects the writing of his twenties; Bull Heart walks through a divorce; More Bull turns toward surrender and simplicity. Complete Bull gathers all three into one volume.

name: Brian's Poem of the Day
tagline: Five years of writing a poem every morning, gathered into four volumes.
description: For five years Brian published a poem each day. These four volumes select 365 poems apiece — meditations shaped by his reading, his practice, and the people who read along with him.

name: Men Writing for Change
tagline: Poems written together, by the men who came to the retreats.
description: Not Brian's poems alone. These anthologies gather the work of men who sat in council circle, wrote, and read aloud to one another — the same weekend that continues each January as Rooted in the Land.
